143:   void doQueryFirstScoring(Bits acceptDocs, LeafCollector collector, DocsAndCost[] dims)

147:     // Specialize the single-dim use-case as we have a more efficient implementation for that:
148:     if (dims.length == 1) {
149:       doQueryFirstScoringSingleDim(acceptDocs, collector, dims[0]);
150:       return;
151:     }

154:     List<DocsAndCost> sidewaysDims = new ArrayList<>(dims.length);
155:     sidewaysDims.addAll(List.of(dims));
156:     CollectionUtil.timSort(sidewaysDims, APPROXIMATION_COMPARATOR);

174:     // has advanced beyond the docID the rest of the dimensions are positioned on. This functions
175:     // a bit like the "head" queue in WANDScorer's "min should match" implementation. We use a
176:     // single-valued PQ ordered by docID to easily determine the "closest" runaway dim we'll use
177:     // for advancing in the case that multiple dim approximations miss.
178:     PriorityQueue<DocsAndCost> runawayDim =
179:         new PriorityQueue<>(1) {
180:           @Override
181:           protected boolean lessThan(DocsAndCost a, DocsAndCost b) {
182:             return a.approximation.docID() < b.approximation.docID();
183:           }
184:         };

191:

193:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
194:         continue;
195:       }
196: 
197:       // If we carried a "runaway" over from the last iteration, see if we've "caught up" yet:
198:       DocsAndCost runaway = runawayDim.top();
199:       if (runaway != null && runaway.approximation.docID() <= docID) {
200:         runawayDim.clear();
201:         runaway = null;
202:       }
203: 
204:       // Check the sideways dim approximations. At most, one dim is allowed to miss for the doc
205:       // to be a near-miss or full match. If multiple sideways dims miss, we move on:
206:       for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysDims) {
207:         int dimDocID = advanceIfBehind(docID, dim.approximation);

209:           DocsAndCost evicted = runawayDim.insertWithOverflow(dim);
210:           if (evicted != null) {
211:             // More than one dim has advanced beyond docID, so we jump ahead to the "closer" of
212:             // the two:
213:             int next = evicted.approximation.docID();
214:             docID = baseApproximation.advance(next);
215:             continue nextDoc;
216:           }
217:         }
218:       }
219: 
220:       // At this point, we have an "approximate" near-miss or full match, but we still need
221:       // to confirm two-phase iterators. First, check the base two-phase (it's always required):
222:       if (baseTwoPhase != null && baseTwoPhase.matches() == false) {
223:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
224:         continue;
225:       }
226: 
227:       // If we have two-phase iterators for our sideways dims, check them now. At most, one
228:       // sideways dim can miss for the doc to be a near-miss or full match. If more than one misses
229:       // we move on:
230:       DocsAndCost failedDim = runawayDim.top();
231:       if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims != null) {
232:         if (failedDim == null) {
233:           // If all sideways dims matched in their approximation phase, then we can allow one
234:           // second-phase check to fail:
235:           for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysTwoPhaseDims) {
236:             assert dim.approximation.docID() == docID;
237:             if (dim.twoPhase.matches() == false) {
238:               if (failedDim != null) {
239:                 // Two second-phase checks have failed, so we move on:
240:                 docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
241:                 continue nextDoc;
242:               } else {
243:                 failedDim = dim;
244:               }
245:             }
246:           }
247:         } else {
248:           // If a sideways dim failed the approximate check, then no second-phase checks can fail:
249:           for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysTwoPhaseDims) {
250:             if (failedDim == dim) {
251:               continue;
252:             }
253:             assert dim.approximation.docID() == docID;
254:             if (dim.twoPhase.matches() == false) {
255:               docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
256:               continue nextDoc;
257:             }
258:           }
259:         }
260:       }
261: 
262:       collectDocID = docID;
263:       if (failedDim == null) {
264:         // Hit passed all filters, so it's "real":
265:         collectHit(collector, sidewaysDims);
266:       } else {
267:         // Hit missed exactly one dim:
268:         collectNearMiss(failedDim.sidewaysLeafCollector);
269:       }
270: 
271:       docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
272:     }

277:       return iterator.advance(docID);
278:     } else {
279:       return iterator.docID();
